SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT f.id) FROM public.flight AS f JOIN public.event AS e ON f.id = e.flight_id JOIN public.concept AS c ON e.kind_id = c.id WHERE c.key = 'motor_failure' LIMIT 201

SELECT count(DISTINCT metadata::jsonb ->> 'sys_hw') FROM public.flight
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT flight_id) FROM semantic.events WHERE kind IN ('takeoff', 'landing') GROUP BY flight_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT kind) = 2 LIMIT 201

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT flight_id) FROM public.event WHERE flight_id IN (SELECT flight_id FROM public.event WHERE kind_id IN (SELECT id FROM public.concept WHERE key = 'takeoff')) AND flight_id IN (SELECT flight_id FROM public.event WHERE kind_id IN (SELECT id FROM public.concept WHERE key = 'landing')) LIMIT 201

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT flight_id) FROM public.event WHERE flight_id IN (SELECT flight_id FROM public.event WHERE kind_id IN (SELECT id FROM public.concept WHERE key IN ('takeoff', 'landing')) GROUP BY flight_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT kind_id) = 2) LIMIT 201
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT flight_id) FROM semantic.flights WHERE NOT flight_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT flight_id FROM semantic.events) LIMIT 201
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT f.id) FROM public.flight AS f LEFT JOIN public.event AS e ON f.id = e.flight_id WHERE e.id IS NULL LIMIT 201
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT f.id) FROM public.flight AS f LEFT JOIN public.event AS e ON f.id = e.flight_id WHERE e.id IS NULL LIMIT 201
SELECT ROUND(CAST(AVG(duration_s) / 60 AS DECIMAL), 1) AS avg_duration_minutes FROM semantic.flights LIMIT 201
SELECT ROUND(CAST(AVG(duration_s) / 60 AS DECIMAL), 1) AS avg_duration_minutes FROM public.flight LIMIT 201
SELECT ROUND(CAST(AVG(duration_s) / 60 AS DECIMAL), 1) AS average_flight_duration_minutes FROM public.flight LIMIT 201
SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY duration_s) AS median_duration FROM public.flight LIMIT 201
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT flight_id) FROM semantic.flights WHERE duration_s > 600 LIMIT 201
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT id) FROM public.flight WHERE duration_s > 600 LIMIT 201
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT id) FROM public.flight WHERE duration_s > 600 LIMIT 201

SELECT ROUND(CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT e.flight_id) * 100.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT f.flight_id) AS DECIMAL), 1) AS percentage FROM semantic.flights AS f LEFT JOIN semantic.events AS e ON f.flight_id = e.flight_id AND e.severity = 2 LIMIT 201

SELECT ROUND(CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT e.flight_id) * 100.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT f.id) AS DECIMAL), 1) AS critical_event_percentage FROM public.flight AS f LEFT JOIN public.event AS e ON f.id = e.flight_id AND e.severity = 2 LIMIT 201

SELECT ROUND(CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN e.severity = 1 THEN f.id END) * 100.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT f.id) AS DECIMAL), 1) AS percentage_critical_events FROM public.flight AS f LEFT JOIN public.event AS e ON f.id = e.flight_id LIMIT 201
SELECT board, COUNT(DISTINCT flight_id) AS flight_count FROM semantic.flights GROUP BY board ORDER BY flight_count DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT metadata -> 'sys_hw' AS board, count(DISTINCT id) AS flight_count FROM public.flight GROUP BY metadata -> 'sys_hw' ORDER BY flight_count DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT log_id FROM semantic.flights ORDER BY duration_s DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT id FROM public.flight ORDER BY duration_s DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT log_sha256 FROM public.flight ORDER BY duration_s DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT kind, COUNT(*) AS event_count FROM semantic.events GROUP BY kind ORDER BY event_count DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT c.key AS event_kind, COUNT(*) AS event_count FROM public.event AS e JOIN public.concept AS c ON e.kind_id = c.id GROUP BY c.key ORDER BY event_count DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT kind_id, COUNT(*) AS event_count FROM public.event GROUP BY kind_id ORDER BY event_count DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT failure_mode, COUNT(*) FROM semantic.events WHERE severity = 2 GROUP BY failure_mode LIMIT 201

SELECT fm.key AS failure_mode, COUNT(e.id) AS critical_event_count FROM public.event AS e JOIN public.concept AS fm ON e.kind_id = fm.id WHERE e.severity = 2 AND fm.kind = 'failure_mode' GROUP BY fm.key LIMIT 201

SELECT 
    attrs -> 'failure_mode' AS failure_mode, 
    COUNT(*) AS critical_event_count
FROM 
    event
WHERE 
    severity = 1  -- Assuming severity 1 indicates critical events
GROUP BY 
    attrs -> 'failure_mode'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM semantic.events WHERE start_s <= 10 LIMIT 201
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.event AS e JOIN public.flight AS f ON e.flight_id = f.id WHERE e.ts_start < f.started_at + INTERVAL '10 SECONDS' LIMIT 201

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.event AS e JOIN public.flight AS f ON e.flight_id = f.id WHERE f.started_at IS NOT NULL AND e.ts_start >= f.started_at AND e.ts_start < f.started_at + INTERVAL '10 SECONDS' LIMIT 201
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM semantic.events WHERE kind = 'log_error' AND source = 'log_message' AND description ILIKE '%EKF%' LIMIT 201
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.event WHERE source = 'autopilot' AND description ILIKE '%EKF%' LIMIT 201
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.event AS e JOIN public.concept AS c ON e.kind_id = c.id WHERE e.source = 'autopilot' AND e.description ILIKE '%EKF%' LIMIT 201
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM semantic.events WHERE description ILIKE '%timestamp%' LIMIT 201
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.event WHERE description ILIKE '%timestamp%' LIMIT 201
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.event WHERE description ILIKE '%timestamp%' LIMIT 201
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM semantic.events WHERE severity = 1 LIMIT 201
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.event WHERE severity = 1 LIMIT 201
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.event WHERE severity = 2 LIMIT 201

SELECT f.board, COUNT(e.event_id) AS vibration_high_count FROM semantic.events AS e JOIN semantic.flights AS f ON e.flight_id = f.flight_id WHERE e.kind = 'vibration_high' GROUP BY f.board ORDER BY vibration_high_count DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT f.metadata->>'sys_hw' AS board, count(e.id) AS vibration_high_count 
FROM public.event e 
JOIN public.flight f ON e.flight_id = f.id 
WHERE e.kind_id = (SELECT id FROM public.concept WHERE key = 'vibration_high' AND kind = 'event') 
GROUP BY f.metadata->>'sys_hw' 
ORDER BY vibration_high_count DESC 
LIMIT 1

SELECT flight.source, COUNT(*) AS event_count FROM public.event JOIN public.flight ON event.flight_id = flight.id WHERE event.description = 'vibration_high' GROUP BY flight.source ORDER BY event_count DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM semantic.events AS e JOIN semantic.flights AS f ON e.flight_id = f.flight_id WHERE e.kind = 'battery_low' AND f.board = 'PX4_FMU_V6X' LIMIT 201

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.event AS e JOIN public.flight AS f ON e.flight_id = f.id JOIN public.concept AS c ON e.kind_id = c.id WHERE c.key = 'battery_low' AND CAST(f.metadata AS TEXT) LIKE '%"sys_hw":"PX4_FMU_V6X"%' LIMIT 201
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.event AS e JOIN public.flight AS f ON e.flight_id = f.id WHERE e.description = 'battery_low' AND f.autopilot = 'PX4_FMU_V6X' LIMIT 201

SELECT ROUND(CAST(COALESCE(AVG(critical_event_count), 0) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS avg_critical_events_per_flight FROM (SELECT flight_id, COUNT(*) AS critical_event_count FROM semantic.events WHERE severity = 2 GROUP BY flight_id) AS critical_events_per_flight LIMIT 201

SELECT ROUND(CAST(COALESCE(AVG(event_count), 0) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS avg_critical_events_per_flight FROM (SELECT flight_id, COUNT(*) AS event_count FROM public.event WHERE severity = 2 GROUP BY flight_id) AS critical_events_per_flight LIMIT 201

SELECT ROUND(CAST(COALESCE(AVG(event_count), 0) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS average_critical_events FROM (SELECT flight_id, COUNT(*) AS event_count FROM public.event WHERE severity = 1 GROUP BY flight_id) AS flight_events LIMIT 201
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT flight_id) FROM semantic.flights WHERE pilot_error_labels IS NOT NULL AND 'vibration' = ANY(pilot_error_labels) LIMIT 201
SELECT count(DISTINCT flight_id) FROM public.flight WHERE metadata->'error_labels'::jsonb @> '[]'::jsonb || '2'::jsonb
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT f.id) FROM public.flight AS f JOIN public.event AS e ON f.id = e.flight_id WHERE e.description ILIKE '%vibration%' LIMIT 201
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT flight_id) FROM semantic.flights WHERE pilot_rating = 'good' LIMIT 201
SELECT count(DISTINCT id) FROM public.flight WHERE metadata ->> 'rating' = 'good'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT flight_id) FROM semantic.flights WHERE pilot_feedback IS NOT NULL LIMIT 201
SELECT count(DISTINCT id) FROM public.flight WHERE (metadata->>'feedback') IS NOT NULL AND (metadata->>'feedback') <> 'none'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT flight_id) FROM semantic.signal_summary WHERE signal = 'battery.voltage' AND min_value < 15 LIMIT 201

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT flight_id) FROM public.telemetry JOIN public.vendor_field ON telemetry.vendor_field_id = vendor_field.id JOIN public.field_mapping ON vendor_field.id = field_mapping.vendor_field_id JOIN public.concept ON field_mapping.concept_id = concept.id WHERE concept.key = 'battery.voltage' AND (telemetry.value * field_mapping.scale + field_mapping.offset) < 15 LIMIT 201

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT f.id) FROM public.flight AS f JOIN public.telemetry AS t ON f.id = t.flight_id JOIN public.vendor_field AS vf ON t.vendor_field_id = vf.id JOIN public.field_mapping AS fm ON vf.id = fm.vendor_field_id JOIN public.concept AS c ON fm.concept_id = c.id WHERE c.key = 'battery_voltage' AND t.value < 15 LIMIT 201
SELECT MAX(max_value) AS max_vibration FROM semantic.signal_summary WHERE signal = 'vibration.accel' LIMIT 201

SELECT MAX(telemetry.value * field_mapping.scale + field_mapping."offset") AS max_vibration FROM public.telemetry JOIN public.vendor_field ON telemetry.vendor_field_id = vendor_field.id JOIN public.field_mapping ON vendor_field.id = field_mapping.vendor_field_id JOIN public.concept ON field_mapping.concept_id = concept.id WHERE concept.kind = 'signal' AND concept.key = 'vibration.accel' LIMIT 201

SELECT MAX(t.value) AS max_accelerometer_vibration FROM public.telemetry AS t JOIN public.vendor_field AS vf ON t.vendor_field_id = vf.id JOIN public.field_mapping AS fm ON vf.id = fm.vendor_field_id JOIN public.concept AS c ON fm.concept_id = c.id WHERE c.key = 'accelerometer_vibration' AND c.kind = 'signal' LIMIT 201
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT flight_id) FROM semantic.telemetry WHERE signal = 'gps.eph' AND value > 5 LIMIT 201

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT flight_id) FROM public.telemetry JOIN public.vendor_field ON telemetry.vendor_field_id = vendor_field.id JOIN public.field_mapping ON vendor_field.id = field_mapping.vendor_field_id JOIN public.concept ON field_mapping.concept_id = concept.id WHERE concept.key = 'gps.eph' AND (telemetry.value * field_mapping.scale + field_mapping."offset") > 5 LIMIT 201

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT f.id) FROM public.flight AS f JOIN public.telemetry AS t ON f.id = t.flight_id JOIN public.vendor_field AS vf ON t.vendor_field_id = vf.id JOIN public.field_mapping AS fm ON vf.id = fm.vendor_field_id JOIN public.concept AS c ON fm.concept_id = c.id WHERE c.key = 'gps_horizontal_accuracy' AND t.value > 5 LIMIT 201
SELECT f.log_id FROM semantic.signal_summary AS ss JOIN semantic.flights AS f ON ss.flight_id = f.flight_id WHERE ss.signal = 'battery.voltage' ORDER BY ss.max_value DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT f.id FROM public.flight AS f JOIN public.telemetry AS t ON f.id = t.flight_id JOIN public.vendor_field AS vf ON t.vendor_field_id = vf.id JOIN public.field_mapping AS fm ON vf.id = fm.vendor_field_id JOIN public.concept AS c ON fm.concept_id = c.id WHERE c.key = 'battery.voltage' ORDER BY t.value DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT f.id FROM public.flight AS f JOIN public.telemetry AS t ON f.id = t.flight_id JOIN public.vendor_field AS vf ON t.vendor_field_id = vf.id JOIN public.field_mapping AS fm ON vf.id = fm.vendor_field_id JOIN public.concept AS c ON fm.concept_id = c.id WHERE c.key = 'battery_voltage' ORDER BY t.value DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT f.board, ROUND(CAST(AVG(ss.max_value) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS avg_peak_vibration FROM semantic.flights AS f JOIN semantic.signal_summary AS ss ON f.flight_id = ss.flight_id WHERE ss.signal = 'vibration.accel' GROUP BY f.board ORDER BY avg_peak_vibration DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT f.metadata ->> 'sys_hw' AS board, round(max(t.value * fm.scale + fm."offset")::numeric, 1) AS peak_vibration
FROM public.flight f
JOIN public.telemetry t ON f.id = t.flight_id
JOIN public.vendor_field vf ON t.vendor_field_id = vf.id
JOIN public.field_mapping fm ON vf.id = fm.vendor_field_id
JOIN public.concept c ON fm.concept_id = c.id
WHERE c.kind = 'signal' AND c.key = 'vibration.accel'
GROUP BY f.metadata ->> 'sys_hw'
ORDER BY peak_vibration DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT vf.autopilot, AVG(t.value) AS avg_peak_vibration FROM public.flight AS f JOIN public.telemetry AS t ON f.id = t.flight_id JOIN public.vendor_field AS vf ON t.vendor_field_id = vf.id JOIN public.field_mapping AS fm ON vf.id = fm.vendor_field_id JOIN public.concept AS c ON fm.concept_id = c.id WHERE c.key = 'vibration' AND c.kind = 'signal' GROUP BY vf.autopilot ORDER BY avg_peak_vibration DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT unit FROM public.concept WHERE key = 'vibration.accel' LIMIT 201
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM semantic.signals WHERE subsystem = 'power' LIMIT 201

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT signal.id) FROM public.concept AS signal JOIN public.concept_relation AS relation ON signal.id = relation.src_id JOIN public.concept AS subsystem ON relation.dst_id = subsystem.id WHERE signal.kind = 'signal' AND subsystem.key = 'power' LIMIT 201
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.concept WHERE key ILIKE '%power%' AND kind = 'signal' LIMIT 201
SELECT related_concept FROM semantic.ontology WHERE concept = 'battery.voltage' AND relation = 'indicates' LIMIT 201

SELECT DISTINCT fm.id, fm.key FROM public.concept AS fm JOIN public.concept_relation AS cr ON fm.id = cr.dst_id JOIN public.concept AS sig ON cr.src_id = sig.id WHERE sig.key = 'battery.voltage' AND sig.kind = 'signal' AND fm.kind = 'failure_mode' LIMIT 201
SELECT DISTINCT subsystem FROM semantic.signals LIMIT 201
SELECT DISTINCT c.key AS subsystem FROM public.concept AS c JOIN public.concept_relation AS cr ON c.id = cr.dst_id WHERE cr.rel = 'part_of' AND c.kind = 'signal' LIMIT 201
SELECT DISTINCT v.field FROM public.vendor_field AS v JOIN public.field_mapping AS fm ON v.id = fm.vendor_field_id JOIN public.concept AS c ON fm.concept_id = c.id WHERE c.kind = 'signal' LIMIT 201

SELECT t.value FROM public.flight AS f JOIN public.telemetry AS t ON f.id = t.flight_id JOIN public.vendor_field AS vf ON t.vendor_field_id = vf.id JOIN public.field_mapping AS fm ON vf.id = fm.vendor_field_id JOIN public.concept AS c ON fm.concept_id = c.id WHERE c.key = 'wind_speed' AND f.duration_s = (SELECT MAX(duration_s) FROM public.flight) LIMIT 201
